blocks.text: Rere Madrid and Kai Sotto have officially welcomed parenthood as they announced that the actress has given birth to their first child, a baby boy. Madrid made the announcement through her Instagram Stories on Tuesday, Sept. 29, showing the Gilas Pilipinas player at a hospital room, all-smiles while carrying the newborn. “A blessing I will love, nurture, and protect with everything I have,” the actress said in the caption. Sotto, for his part, expressed gratitude for Madrid’s safe delivery of their baby while sharing a photo of the actress lying in a hospital bed, with her face partly covered by a towel. […]...
